summary: Iteration 39 – Hetzner S3 storage migration + Fahrkontrolle PDF with photo thumbnails. 20/20 backend pytest PASS on preview URL. All upload endpoints (/api/upload, /api/settings/business/logo, /api/vku/permit-upload, /api/accounting/expenses/upload-receipt, /api/students/{id}/documents, /api/fahrkontrolle/…/photo) verified to write to Hetzner bucket 'saferide'. Byte-identical md5 round-trip via GET /api/files/{path}. Legacy Emergent fallback works for pre-migration files still referenced in db.files. Fahrkontrolle PDF with photo embeds image XObject correctly; regression pass for photo-only cell, rating+comment-only cell, and no-photo path. All regression endpoints (backup/mongo, monthly PDF, income-statement PDF, invoice PDF, appointments CRUD, iCal feed) unchanged.
critical_code_review_comments: core/storage.py: clean single-responsibility module; lazy _get_s3() singleton is correct; Emergent fallback only triggered on NoSuchKey/404/NotFound → other ClientError → 502 (correct FAIL-FAST behaviour). Signature-v4 + path-style addressing correctly configured for Hetzner Falkenstein. GOOD.

put_object() sets CacheControl='public, max-age=31536000, immutable' on every write — great for static asset performance. Note: files served through GET /api/files/{path} also carry a matching Cache-Control header. Consistent.

boto3/botocore imports are SYNCHRONOUS calls executed from async FastAPI endpoints (put_object, get_object). Blocks the event loop briefly (~50–150 ms per network round-trip). For low traffic this is fine, but under bursts it can starve other requests. Recommendation: wrap S3 calls in `await asyncio.to_thread(...)` or use aioboto3. (Also flagged in iter36 review — carried over.)

S3 credentials are stored plaintext in /app/backend/.env AND are LIVE Hetzner keys with full bucket access. Any leak of the .env leaks the bucket. Consider migrating to per-instance IAM-style credentials or Hetzner’s bucket-scoped access keys with read-only fallback for prod.

delete_object() is best-effort silent on ClientError → good UX for Fahrkontrolle photo delete (won’t break UX if bucket blip). But because Fahrkontrolle DELETE .../photo intentionally does NOT call delete_object (per iter39 spec: safety guard against other refs), the bucket accumulates orphan blobs whenever a rating cell is trimmed. Consider a background job (`db.files + delete_object`) periodic cleanup, or reference-counting via db.files.

fahrkontrolle_pdf._load_photo() uses a MODULE-level _PHOTO_CACHE dict that is never cleared. Every PDF export leaks all fetched thumbnails into process memory for the lifetime of the worker. Fix: move the cache into export_fahrkontrolle_pdf() as a local dict, or use functools.lru_cache with maxsize=32.
_read_from_emergent() catches on 403 → re-inits key → retries once (nice). But token is process-global; if key rotates it stays stale until process restart. Acceptable for read-only legacy fallback.

Fahrkontrolle PDF: journal-loop re-renders badge + title + comment on new page after a page break BEFORE drawing photos — but does NOT re-render the *entry* itself if the badge/title fit but the photos don’t. Verified by test that PDF stays valid; visual QA still recommended when a cell has 4 photos near the page boundary.
test_iteration38_photos.py still uses instance-method class-scoped fixtures → pytest deprecation warning. Non-blocking. Iter39 test file avoids the pattern where possible.
test_credentials: admin@saferide.ch / SafeRide2026! (from /app/memory/test_credentials.md). S3 creds loaded from /app/backend/.env.
seed_data_creation: Test creates ephemeral: 3 students (first_name=TEST_it39), 1 fk_category, 2 fk_subitems, 1 lesson, 1 invoice, 1 appointment. All uploads to Hetzner tagged saferide/... under uploads/, logo/, vku-permits/, expenses/, students/{id}/, fahrkontrolle/. Session-finish teardown deletes DB rows + calls delete_object() for every uploaded path. Leftover DB rows from pytest-xdist workers were cleaned manually. Hetzner bucket contains 14 total objects (mixture of main-agent self-test + a few remaining orphans from prior iterations — not from this test run).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Hetzner S3 migration is LIVE. Bucket 'saferide' in Falkenstein. Config keys: S3_ENDPOINT_URL, S3_REGION, S3_BUCKET, S3_ACCESS_KEY, S3_SECRET_KEY (all in /app/backend/.env). ALL upload endpoints route through core.storage.put_object() → Hetzner. get_object() tries Hetzner first, then falls back to Emergent for legacy files (db.files entries older than 2026-07). Fahrkontrolle PDF (routers/fahrkontrolle_pdf.py) has a new _load_photo() helper + _PHOTO_CACHE that fetches image bytes via core.storage.get_object and embeds up to 4 25×25 mm thumbnails per rating cell. Journal now includes cells with photo_urls != [] even when comment is empty. When testing anything touching uploads, prefer /api/upload → /api/files/{path} md5 roundtrip. For Hetzner-config-missing negative test: temporarily unset S3_* env vars → put_object() returns 503 'Speicher-Konfiguration unvollständig'. Not automated in tests because it requires a service restart.
rca of the issue: N/A – no bugs found. Two initial pytest failures were test-harness artefacts (solid-grey PNG produced 7.9 KB PDF vs 8 KB assertion, and pytest-xdist worker didn't auto-load /app/backend/.env for direct core.storage import). Both fixed by relaxing the PDF size threshold to 6 KB while adding a stricter '/Subtype /Image' presence assertion, and by manually loading backend/.env in the storage-config test. No backend code changes required.
